config.label: Lindo AI API key
config.description: Lindo AI API key. Create one at https://app.lindo.ai under Workspace Settings → API Keys. Requires a Business or Whitelabel plan.

config.label: OAuth 2
config.description: OAuth 2.1 Bearer token. Most MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Smithery) obtain this automatically via the server's OAuth flow on first connect — no manual setup required. Format: 'Bearer <token>'.
